purpose: Leave open a possibility while attaching a condition or reservation.
keywords: Vない + ものでもない
If the terms suit me, I might take it on.
With the right explanation, I might be able to understand.
With some ingenuity, finishing in one day is not impossible.
formation: Vない + ものでもない
restrictions: Often amounts to a conditional willingness.
mistake: The double negative weakly allows the action; it is not a firm promise.
